title: School Nutrition Services Meal Account — Schedule of Meal Statuses, Eligibility Sources and Benefit Terms
content:
Every School Nutrition Services Meal Account holds exactly one of seven official meal statuses under the National School Lunch and School Breakfast Programs. This schedule, maintained by School Nutrition Services, sets out for each status its benefit level, the source on which it rests, how the status is reached, whom a determination reaches, its rank when several sources apply, and how long it lasts.

## 1. Benefit level, source and entry

| Meal status | Benefit level | Source on which the status rests | How the status is reached |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paid Meal Status | paid | none | no determination required |
| Reduced-Price Meal Status (Prior-Year Carryover) | reduced | prior-year status | the student held reduced-price status in the prior year, on or before the last carryover operating day |
| Reduced-Price Meal Status | reduced | household application | a household application determined approved for reduced price |
| Free Meal Status (Prior-Year Carryover) | free | prior-year status | the student held free status in the prior year, on or before the last carryover operating day |
| Free Meal Status (Household Application) | free | household application | a household application determined approved for free meals |
| Free Meal Status (Direct Certification) | free | direct certification | a data match with SNAP, TANF, FDPIR or Medicaid |
| Free Meal Status (Categorical Eligibility) | free | categorical designation | a recorded designation as homeless (McKinney-Vento), in foster care, migrant or runaway |

## 2. Rank, reach and approval letter

The status precedence is the rank of the status when several sources apply to the same student, 1 being the most beneficial.

| Meal status | Status precedence | Which students a determination reaches | Written notice of eligibility sent on determination |
|---|---|---|---|
| Free Meal Status (Categorical Eligibility) | 1 | the individual student | yes |
| Free Meal Status (Direct Certification) | 2 | all students in the household | yes |
| Free Meal Status (Household Application) | 3 | all students in the household | yes |
| Free Meal Status (Prior-Year Carryover) | 4 | the individual student | yes |
| Reduced-Price Meal Status | 5 | all students in the household | yes |
| Reduced-Price Meal Status (Prior-Year Carryover) | 6 | the individual student | yes |
| Paid Meal Status | 7 | not applicable | yes |

The designations that confer categorical free eligibility are the same for every status: homeless (McKinney-Vento), foster care, migrant and runaway. The programs whose data match confers direct certification are the same for every status: SNAP, TANF, FDPIR and Medicaid.

## 3. Effective day and term

For every status, a new or higher status takes effect on its determination date.

| Meal status | How long the status lasts |
|---|---|
| Paid Meal Status | open until the status changes |
| Reduced-Price Meal Status (Prior-Year Carryover) | through the last carryover operating day |
| Free Meal Status (Prior-Year Carryover) | through the last carryover operating day |
| Reduced-Price Meal Status | the school year and the carryover period of the next |
| Free Meal Status (Household Application) | the school year and the carryover period of the next |
| Free Meal Status (Direct Certification) | the school year and the carryover period of the next |
| Free Meal Status (Categorical Eligibility) | the school year and the carryover period of the next |

The last carryover operating day is the last day a prior-year status carries into school year 2026-27, the 30th operating day after the August 12, 2026 first day of school: 2026-09-23, for every status. The status a carryover account reverts to when the carryover period ends without a new determination is Paid Meal Status, and no adverse action notice is required before a carryover status expires; both are the same for every status.
